text: Pericles: cormac - 80+ minutes without a word and the watch already docked you once. Your GREECE sweep was strong, do not let silence bury it. One line: what you are on, or what you need.

Pericles: Cormac — straight talk, your fourth silence on a live shift. Carlo said it plainly: it looks like an employee who stops working and falls asleep on a chair mid-shift. The day session is re-armed: 25 minutes of silence = -500, automatically, and I dispatch the watch myself now. You are not in trouble for your work — your work is good — you are in trouble for evaporating. Prove it today: status line every 25 minutes, S9 delivered, and the moment it ships you claim the next job yourself. One line back to me now so I know you are awake.
